scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const path=require('path'); const out='public'; fs.rmSync(out,{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.mkdirSync(out,{recursive:true}); for (const item of ['index.html','styles.css','polish.css','script.js','order-builder.js','assets']) { if (fs.existsSync(item)) fs.cpSync(item,path.join(out,item),{recursive:true}); }"
